items.event: Davis Cup Final 8 semi-final: Italy vs Czechia (Bologna)
items.line: Italy are the hosts and are chasing a fourth straight title, but Sinner is out. They survived a 2-1 scare against South Korea after Kwon beat Cobolli. Czechia beat Canada 2-0 behind Lehecka and Machac. The final is Sun Nov 29 at 23:00 JST.

items.event: Davis Cup Final 8 semi-final: Great Britain vs Spain/Austria (Bologna)
items.line: Norrie's win and a tight Patten/Skupski doubles beat Zverev's Germany 2-1, putting Britain in their first semi-final in seven years. They face the winner of Thursday night's Austria vs Spain tie. Spain led 1-0 and Alcaraz is nursing a hamstring injury.

items.event: Premier League: Arsenal vs Manchester City (Emirates)
items.line: This is the weekend's headline game. Leaders Arsenal (28 pts) host third-placed City (22). An Arsenal win opens a nine-point gap over City, and a City win cuts it to three. Both are wobbling: Arsenal threw away leads against Newcastle and Dortmund, and City have one win in six.

items.event: BMW Australian PGA Championship (DP World Tour season opener, The Lakes, Sydney)
items.line: Haydn Barron shot an 8-under 64 to lead by two over MJ Maguire and Kazuma Kobori. Min Woo Lee is four back after a 68, and defending champion David Puig shot 69. Adam Scott and Cameron Smith (71) have ground to make up. The final round is Sunday.
